title: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review - notes
content:
Meeting: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review
Date: 2026-03-12 (draft notes)
Owner: Samira Khan (eng-sre)
Attendees (expected): Samira, Ethan, Priya, Marcus, Leah (oncall lead), noah (monitoring)

Agenda:
- Quick status: SLOs + error budget
- Paging trends + PD noise reduction updates
- Top incidents (last 7 days) + RCA plan owners
- Action items + next steps
- Parking lot / follow-ups

SLO Summary (current):
- Inference API availability SLO: 99.95% monthly target
  - Current month to date: 99.92% -> slight burn.
  - Error budget remaining: ~72% (approx 8.6 days equivalent at current burn rate)
- 99th pct latency SLO (text-gen): target < 200ms tail
  - Current 99p: 210ms (missed by ~10ms)
  - Primary contributor: bursts on large-seq requests and single-tenant Dedicated noisy neighbors
- Embedding pipeline SLO: 99.9% success
  - Current: 99.99% (healthy)

Notes: need to surface per-region SLOs in dashboard next week (US-west still highest tail). Link: Confluence SLO Dashboard

Paging trends (last 14 days):
- Total pages: 38 (vs 52 previous period) -> improvement in noise-reduction work, but still > target (<=30/wk)
- Top page sources: autoscaler flaps (12), model-oom / GPU OOM (9), kv-cache eviction storms (7), latency spikes due to long prompts (6), infra control-plane 4xx errors (4)
- Mean time to acknowledge (MTTA): 4m 20s (goal < 3m)
- Mean time to resolve (MTTR): 1h 15m (goal < 45m)

Observations:
- Autoscaler flaps reduced after tweak to cooldown windows (PR merged: serving-runtime#842) but still see edge cases when bursty traffic + reserved pools overlap.
- GPU OOMs correlate with recent model rollouts that increased sequence length defaults. Need stricter preflight checks.
- Kv-cache eviction storms happen when prefix cache TTLs expire concurrently after rolling restart; workaround: stagger TTL refreshes and add backoff jitter.

Top incidents (summary):
1) INC-2026-03-08-01: Large inference latency spike (US-west)
   - Time: 2026-03-08 14:22 UTC -> 14:58 UTC
   - Impact: 15% error rate on text-generation route; multiple pages to SRE and Oncall
   - Root cause (initial): autoscaler returned insufficient capacity during sudden traffic surge; fallback routing misconfigured causing retries to overload a single pod
   - Mitigation: manual scale up + temporary routing bypass; rolled back recent routing change
   - Follow-up actions: adjust autoscaler thresholds, add circuit-breaker on retries, add test for fallback routing (owner: Ethan Lee, due 2026-03-19)

2) INC-2026-03-09-02: GPU OOMs during model variant rollout
   - Time: 2026-03-09 03:10 UTC -> 2026-03-09 06:30 UTC
   - Impact: Dedicated customers experienced degraded throughput on a subset of pools; internal retries caused queueing
   - Root cause: new default seq_len config on model-variant not validated in preflight; kernel memory pressure + fragmenting memory allocations
   - Mitigation: roll back variant, increase per-pod memory limit, add preflight load test
   - Follow-ups: add preflight seq_len sweep to model onboarding; ops playbook update (owner: Priya Desai, due 2026-03-18)

3) INC-2026-03-10-03: kv-cache eviction storm after rolling restart
   - Time: 2026-03-10 11:05 UTC -> 11:45 UTC
   - Impact: latency jitter for chat workloads; transient 99p spikes
   - Root cause: TTL sync caused simultaneous cache misses; no jitter in refresh logic
   - Mitigation: applied rolling restart with staggered TTLs and tuned cache rebuild backoff
   - Follow-ups: implement jitter + exponential backoff in cache refresh (owner: Marcus Chen, due 2026-03-17)

RCA status: all incidents triaged, two full RCAs scheduled (INC-2026-03-08-01, INC-2026-03-09-02). Expected RCA docs to Confluence by 2026-03-20.

Monitoring / dashboards:
- Need a new dashboard tile for per-model seq_len distribution and 99p latency overlay (helps catch model rollouts that increase tail).
- Add a per-customer Dedicated pool health view (to spot noisy neighbor effects earlier).
- Alert tuning: lower sensitivity on kv-cache transient errors but add runbook for eviction storms.

Action items (owner - due - notes):
- Ethan Lee - 2026-03-19 - Add circuit-breaker + retry caps and test for fallback routing; create JIRA SRE-356.
- Priya Desai - 2026-03-18 - Add seq_len preflight checks into model onboarding; update onboarding checklist.
- Marcus Chen - 2026-03-17 - Implement jitter/backoff for cache refresh; create small e2e to validate.
- Leah (oncall lead) - 2026-03-15 - Run PD runbook workshop with oncall rotation to reduce MTTA; create rota improvements doc.
- Samira Khan - 2026-03-14 - Surface per-region SLO tiles on ops dashboard; coordinate with monitoring team.

Parking lot / questions for Product/Infra:
- Product: can we gate the model-variant rollout UI to require seq_len limits per target pool? (ask PM: Miguel)
- Infra: capacity forecasting for Dedicated pools during marketing campaigns (responsible: infra team)

Notes to self / convo starters for next sync:
- Show before/after charts for autoscaler cooldown tweak (PR link in linked artifacts)
- Bring sample long-prompt trace to discuss retry behavior + client guidance
- Follow up on PD noise reduction playbook status

References / links:
- Confluence SLO Dashboard (linked)
- JIRA tickets: JIRA-SRE-342, JIRA-INF-778
- PR: serving-runtime#842 (autoscaler cooldown change)

Next meeting: 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC (tentative)

End of draft notes.
